findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, and Referrer-Policy headers are all absent. Site is vulnerable to MIME-type sniffing, clickjacking, and referrer leakage.
findings.recommendation: Add headers via Vercel vercel.json configuration

findings.title: Broad CORS policy
findings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is set on all responses. Acceptable for static content site but could be tightened.
findings.recommendation: Review if broad CORS is needed for all paths

findings.title: Missing changefreq and priority in sitemap
findings.description: Sitemap entries lack changefreq and priority attributes, reducing crawl optimization signals.
findings.recommendation: Add changefreq (daily/weekly/monthly) and priority (0.1-1.0) to sitemap entries

findings.title: FAQPage schema deprecated by Google
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for ALL sites on May 7, 2026. The FAQPage structured data is valid JSON-LD but no longer generates Google SERP rich results. Per guidelines, flag at Info, do not recommend removal — still valid for other search engines.
findings.recommendation: Keep FAQPage schema (valid, benefits Bing/DuckDuckGo). Consider QAPage for genuine user Q&A instead.

findings.title: Pricing signal discrepancy
findings.description: Schema.org Offer.price is 4.99 but HTML comment says price should be '0' while free in early access, and meta description says 'Free while in early access.' This creates confusion for search engines.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile: either update Offer.price to 0 or update all copy to say $4.99

findings.description: Blog posts lack structured data, missing rich result opportunities.

findings.title: 6 animated GIF files on homepage
findings.description: GIFs: l2cache-jwt.gif, l2cache-ocr.gif, terminal-history.gif, l2cache-sql-smart.gif, custom-smart-actions.gif, and one more. Animated GIFs waste 70-80% bandwidth vs video/WebP.
findings.recommendation: Convert to <video autoplay muted loop> or animated WebP

findings.title: Missing crossorigin on font preconnect
findings.description: Google Fonts preconnect lacks crossorigin attribute. Can cause FOIT/FOUT.
findings.recommendation: Add crossorigin to Google Fonts link

findings.title: Missing fonts.gstatic.com preconnect
findings.description: Only fonts.googleapis.com is preconnected. fonts.gstatic.com (where fonts are actually loaded from) is not.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

findings.title: No loading=lazy on images
findings.description: No images use loading='lazy' attribute. Below-fold screenshots may cause unnecessary LCP pressure.
findings.recommendation: Add loading='lazy' to all below-fold images
